fusions.name: Silver Followers
fusions.desc: Looses 3 silver darts that drift slowly outward, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoal Wheels Round
fusions.desc: Sends a packed shoal into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage and leaving it [Slowed] for 6 seconds. On a hit, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sheltering Belly
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. For 6 seconds, the shoal sheltering under you darts out beside you, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Among Many
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
